etsy.title: Amigurumi Chick Crochet Pattern PDF, Easy Easter Chick, Tested Pattern with Stitch Chart, Baby Chick Toy, English German Hungarian
etsy.description:
A chubby little chick you can finish in an afternoon: one body worked top-down, a beak, two wings and a tuft. About 2 hours.

TESTED PATTERN: the photos show a chick made by a pattern tester from this exact pattern (shown in plush yarn). Her feedback on eye, beak and wing placement is built into the instructions.

• Skill level: intermediate (5/6), you need magic ring, sc, increase and decrease
• Size: about 7 cm (2.75 in) tall in worsted yarn; bigger in plush or chenille yarn
• Hook: 3.5 mm
• Yarn: about 15 g yellow + 2 g orange, two 6 mm safety eyes, fibrefill

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Round-by-round instructions with stitch count for every round
• Exact placement: eyes between rounds 4 and 5, beak on round 6, wings at round 7
• Stitch chart, finished-shape sketch and symbol key
• Tip for making a bigger chick

WAYS TO USE IT: Easter basket filler, spring table decor, a small gift for a baby, a keyring (make it smaller with thinner yarn).

PDF PATTERN ONLY – not the finished item. Instant download in 3 languages: English (US terms + UK table), German (Deutsch) and Hungarian (magyar).
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales with credit to AureliaVenn. Please don't share or resell the pattern.

Written with the help of AI tools; stitch counts checked round by round and tested by a maker.
